gold_clauses.title: Position and Scope of Duties
gold_clauses.key_quote: employ Employee as Chief Technology Officer

gold_clauses.title: Confidentiality and Trade Secrets
gold_clauses.key_quote: hold all such confidential information in strict secrecy

gold_clauses.title: Non-Compete and Non-Solicitation
gold_clauses.key_quote: period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment, Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in or assist any business that directly competes

gold_clauses.key_quote: assigns to Company all right, title, and interest in and to any and all inventions

gold_clauses.key_quote: laws of the State of California
